name: Data Cleanup Daily
script:
# Code for Server Script (Scheduler Event, Daily).
# Uses only safe_exec API: frappe.*, log. No imports.

log("Data Cleanup: start")
rules = frappe.get_doc("Data Cleanup Rules")
today = frappe.utils.getdate()
log("Data Cleanup: today=%s" % (today,))
enabled_version = sum(1 for r in (rules.version_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_comment = sum(1 for r in (rules.comment_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_file = sum(1 for r in (rules.file_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_comm = sum(1 for r in (rules.communication_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_event = sum(1 for r in (rules.event_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_workflow = sum(1 for r in (rules.workflow_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
log("Data Cleanup: rules enabled Version=%s Comment=%s File=%s Communication=%s Event=%s Workflow=%s" % (enabled_version, enabled_comment, enabled_file, enabled_comm, enabled_event, enabled_workflow))

frappe.enqueue(  
    function="dinext_common_data_cleanup",  
    queue="long",          # или "default"/"short"  
    timeout=1500,
    job_name='Dinext Data Cleanup'
)

'''
frappe.enqueue(
	method: str | Callable,
	queue: str = "default",
	timeout: int | None = None,
	event: str | None = None,
	is_async: bool = True,
	job_name: str | None = None,
	now: bool = False,
	enqueue_after_commit: bool = False,
	*,
	on_success: Callable | None = None,
	on_failure: Callable | None = None,
	at_front: bool = False,
	job_id: str | None = None,
	deduplicate=False,
	at_front_when_starved=False,
	**kwargs,
) 
'''

name: Data Cleanup
script:
PAGE_LENGTH = 500
MAX_PACK = 10

def get_one_page(doctype, filters, order_by="name", start=0, or_filters=None):
	return frappe.get_all(
		doctype,
		filters=filters,
		or_filters=or_filters or [],
		fields=["name"],
		order_by=order_by,
		limit_start=start,
		limit_page_length=PAGE_LENGTH,
		pluck="name"
	)

def run_data_cleanup():
	log("Data Cleanup: start")
	rules = frappe.get_doc("Data Cleanup Rules")
	today = frappe.utils.getdate()
	log("Data Cleanup: today=%s" % (today,))
	deleted_total = 0

	# 1. Version Cleanup Rule
	log("Data Cleanup: processing Version rules") 
	for row in (rules.version_rules or []):
		if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
			log("Data Cleanup Version rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
			continue
		cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
		log("Data Cleanup Version rule days=%s ref_doctype=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, row.get("ref_doctype") or "", cutoff))
		filters = [["creation", "<", cutoff]]
		if row.get("ref_doctype"):
			filters.append(["ref_doctype", "=", row.ref_doctype])
		count = 0
		pack_count = 0
		page_num = 0
		start = 0
		while True:
			names = get_one_page("Version", filters, order_by="creation", start=start)
			if not names:
				break
			page_num = page_num + 1
			for name in names:
				try:
					frappe.delete_doc("Version", name, force=1)
					pack_count = pack_count + 1
					count = count + 1
					if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
						frappe.db.commit()
						log("Data Cleanup Version: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
						pack_count = 0
				except Exception as e:
					frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Version delete error for %s" % (name,), e, "Version", name)
					log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Version %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
			log("Data Cleanup Version: page %s, deleted batch %s, total so far %s" % (page_num, len(names), count))
			start = start + PAGE_LENGTH
		if pack_count:
			frappe.db.commit()
		deleted_total = deleted_total + count
		log("Data Cleanup Version rule days=%s ref_doctype=%s deleted=%s" % (row.days, row.get("ref_doctype") or "", count))

	# 2. Comment Cleanup Rule
	log("Data Cleanup: processing Comment rules")
	for row in (rules.comment_rules or []):
		if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
			log("Data Cleanup Comment rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
			continue
		cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
		log("Data Cleanup Comment rule days=%s reference_doctype=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, row.get("reference_doctype") or "all", cutoff))
		doctypes_to_consider = [row.reference_doctype] if row.get("reference_doctype") else frappe.get_all(
			"Comment", filters=[["reference_doctype", "!=", ""]], pluck="reference_doctype", distinct=1)
		count = 0
		for ref_dt in (doctypes_to_consider or []):
			if not ref_dt or not frappe.db.exists("DocType", ref_dt):
				continue
			ref_start = 0
			while True:
				ref_names = frappe.get_all(ref_dt, filters=[["modified", "<", cutoff]], fields=["name"], order_by="name", limit_start=ref_start, limit_page_length=PAGE_LENGTH, pluck="name")
				if not ref_names:
					break
				comment_filters = [["reference_doctype", "=", ref_dt], ["reference_name", "in", ref_names]]
				if row.get("comment_type"):
					comment_filters.append(["comment_type", "=", row.comment_type])
				comment_names = frappe.get_all("Comment", filters=comment_filters, pluck="name")
				pack_count = 0
				for name in comment_names:
					try:
						frappe.delete_doc("Comment", name, force=1)
						pack_count = pack_count + 1
						count = count + 1
						if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
							frappe.db.commit()
							log("Data Cleanup Comment: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
							pack_count = 0
					except Exception as e:
							frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Comment delete error for %s" % (name,), e)
							log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Comment %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
				if pack_count:
					frappe.db.commit()
				ref_start = ref_start + PAGE_LENGTH
		deleted_total = deleted_total + count
		log("Data Cleanup Comment rule days=%s reference_doctype=%s deleted=%s" % (row.days, row.get("reference_doctype") or "all", count))

	# 3. File Cleanup Rule
	log("Data Cleanup: processing File rules")
	for row in (rules.file_rules or []):
		if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
			log("Data Cleanup File rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
			continue
		cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
		log("Data Cleanup File rule days=%s attached_to_doctype=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, row.get("attached_to_doctype") or "all", cutoff))
		doctypes_to_consider = [row.attached_to_doctype] if row.get("attached_to_doctype") else frappe.get_all(
			"File", filters=[["attached_to_doctype", "!=", ""]], pluck="attached_to_doctype", distinct=1)
		count = 0
		for ref_dt in (doctypes_to_consider or []):
			if not ref_dt or not frappe.db.exists("DocType", ref_dt):
				continue
			ref_start = 0
			while True:
				ref_names = frappe.get_all(ref_dt, filters=[["modified", "<", cutoff]], fields=["name"], order_by="name", limit_start=ref_start, limit_page_length=PAGE_LENGTH, pluck="name")
				if not ref_names:
					break
				file_filters = [["attached_to_doctype", "=", ref_dt], ["attached_to_name", "in", ref_names]]
				if row.get("file_type"):
					file_filters.append(["file_type", "=", row.file_type])
				if row.get("visibility") == "Private":
					file_filters.append(["is_private", "=", 1])
				elif row.get("visibility") == "Public":
					file_filters.append(["is_private", "=", 0])
				if row.get("folder"):
					file_filters.append(["folder", "=", row.folder])
				if row.get("file_size") is not None:
					file_filters.append(["file_size", "=", int(row.file_size)])
				if row.get("attached_to_field"):
					file_filters.append(["attached_to_field", "=", row.attached_to_field])
				file_names = frappe.get_all("File", filters=file_filters, pluck="name")
				pack_count = 0
				for name in file_names:
					try:
						frappe.delete_doc("File", name, force=1)
						pack_count = pack_count + 1
						count = count + 1
						if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
							frappe.db.commit()
							log("Data Cleanup File: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
							pack_count = 0
					except Exception as e:
							frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup File delete error for %s" % (name,), e)
							log("Data Cleanup: error deleting File %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
				if pack_count:
					frappe.db.commit()
				ref_start = ref_start + PAGE_LENGTH
		deleted_total = deleted_total + count
		log("Data Cleanup File rule days=%s attached_to_doctype=%s deleted=%s" % (row.days, row.get("attached_to_doctype") or "all", count))

	# 4. Communication Cleanup Rule
	log("Data Cleanup: processing Communication rules")
	for row in (rules.communication_rules or []):
		if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
			log("Data Cleanup Communication rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
			continue
		cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
		log("Data Cleanup Communication rule days=%s reference_doctype=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, row.get("reference_doctype") or "all", cutoff))
		doctypes_to_consider = [row.reference_doctype] if row.get("reference_doctype") else frappe.get_all(
			"Communication", filters=[["reference_doctype", "!=", ""]], pluck="reference_doctype", distinct=1)
		count = 0
		for ref_dt in (doctypes_to_consider or []):
			if not ref_dt or not frappe.db.exists("DocType", ref_dt):
				continue
			ref_start = 0
			while True:
				ref_names = frappe.get_all(ref_dt, filters=[["modified", "<", cutoff]], fields=["name"], order_by="name", limit_start=ref_start, limit_page_length=PAGE_LENGTH, pluck="name")
				if not ref_names:
					break
				comm_filters = [["reference_doctype", "=", ref_dt], ["reference_name", "in", ref_names]]
				if row.get("communication_type"):
					comm_filters.append(["communication_type", "=", row.communication_type])
				if row.get("communication_medium"):
					comm_filters.append(["communication_medium", "=", row.communication_medium])
				comm_names = frappe.get_all("Communication", filters=comm_filters, pluck="name")
				pack_count = 0
				for name in comm_names:
					try:
						frappe.delete_doc("Communication", name, force=1)
						pack_count = pack_count + 1
						count = count + 1
						if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
							frappe.db.commit()
							log("Data Cleanup Communication: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
							pack_count = 0
					except Exception as e:
							frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Communication delete error for %s" % (name,), e)
							log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Communication %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
				if pack_count:
					frappe.db.commit()
				ref_start = ref_start + PAGE_LENGTH
		deleted_total = deleted_total + count
		log("Data Cleanup Communication rule days=%s reference_doctype=%s deleted=%s" % (row.days, row.get("reference_doctype") or "all", count))

	# 5. Event Cleanup Rule
	log("Data Cleanup: processing Event rules")
	for row in (rules.event_rules or []):
		if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
			log("Data Cleanup Event rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
			continue
		cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
		log("Data Cleanup Event rule days=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, cutoff))
		query_base = """
			SELECT name FROM tabEvent
			WHERE GREATEST(
				COALESCE(starts_on, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'),
				COALESCE(ends_on, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'),
				COALESCE(CONCAT(IFNULL(repeat_till, '1000-01-01'), ' 00:00:00'), '1000-01-01 00:00:00')
			) < %s
			"""
		query_extra = ""
		args_base = [cutoff]
		if row.get("event_category"):
			query_extra = query_extra + " AND event_category = %s"
			args_base.append(row.event_category)
		if row.get("event_type"):
			query_extra = query_extra + " AND event_type = %s"
			args_base.append(row.event_type)
		if row.get("status"):
			query_extra = query_extra + " AND status = %s"
			args_base.append(row.status)
		count = 0
		pack_count = 0
		page_num = 0
		offset = 0
		while True:
			query = query_base + query_extra + " ORDER BY name LIMIT %s OFFSET %s"
			args = tuple(args_base) + (PAGE_LENGTH, offset)
			names = [r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql(query, args)]
			if not names:
				break
			page_num = page_num + 1
			for name in names:
				try:
					frappe.delete_doc("Event", name, force=1)
					pack_count = pack_count + 1
					count = count + 1
					if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
						frappe.db.commit()
						log("Data Cleanup Event: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
						pack_count = 0
				except Exception as e:
					frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Event delete error for %s" % (name,), e)
					log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Event %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
			log("Data Cleanup Event: page %s, deleted batch %s, total so far %s" % (page_num, len(names), count))
			offset = offset + PAGE_LENGTH
		if pack_count:
			frappe.db.commit()
		deleted_total = deleted_total + count
		log("Data Cleanup Event rule days=%s deleted=%s" % (row.days, count))

	# 6. Workflow Cleanup Rule
	log("Data Cleanup: processing Workflow rules")
	for row in (rules.workflow_rules or []):
		if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
			log("Data Cleanup Workflow rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
			continue
		cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
		log("Data Cleanup Workflow rule days=%s reference_doctype=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, row.get("reference_doctype") or "", cutoff))
		if frappe.db.exists("DocType", "Workflow Action"):
			filters_wa = [["modified", "<", cutoff]]
			if row.get("reference_doctype"):
				filters_wa.append(["reference_doctype", "=", row.reference_doctype])
			if row.get("status"):
				filters_wa.append(["status", "=", row.status])
			count = 0
			pack_count = 0
			start = 0
			page_num = 0
			while True:
				names = get_one_page("Workflow Action", filters_wa, order_by="modified", start=start)
				if not names:
					break
				page_num = page_num + 1
				for name in names:
					try:
						frappe.delete_doc("Workflow Action", name, force=1)
						pack_count = pack_count + 1
						count = count + 1
						if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
							frappe.db.commit()
							log("Data Cleanup Workflow Action: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
							pack_count = 0
					except Exception as e:
							frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Workflow Action delete error for %s" % (name,), e)
							log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Workflow Action %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
				log("Data Cleanup Workflow Action: page %s, deleted batch %s, total so far %s" % (page_num, len(names), count))
				start = start + PAGE_LENGTH
			if pack_count:
				frappe.db.commit()
			deleted_total = deleted_total + count
			log("Data Cleanup Workflow rule days=%s doctype=Workflow Action deleted=%s" % (row.days, count))
		if frappe.db.exists("DocType", "Workflow Task"):
			filters_wt = [["modified", "<", cutoff]]
			if row.get("reference_doctype"):
				filters_wt.append(["doc", "=", row.reference_doctype])
			if row.get("status"):
				if row.status == "Completed":
					filters_wt.append(["status", "in", ["Completed", "Cancelled"]])
				elif row.status == "Open":
					filters_wt.append(["status", "=", "Working"])
			count = 0
			pack_count = 0
			start = 0
			page_num = 0
			while True:
				names = get_one_page("Workflow Task", filters_wt, order_by="modified", start=start)
				if not names:
					break
				page_num = page_num + 1
				for name in names:
					try:
						frappe.delete_doc("Workflow Task", name, force=1)
						pack_count = pack_count + 1
						count = count + 1
						if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
							frappe.db.commit()
							log("Data Cleanup Workflow Task: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
							pack_count = 0
					except Exception as e:
							frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Workflow Task delete error for %s" % (name,), e)
							log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Workflow Task %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
				log("Data Cleanup Workflow Task: page %s, deleted batch %s, total so far %s" % (page_num, len(names), count))
				start = start + PAGE_LENGTH
			if pack_count:
				frappe.db.commit()
			deleted_total = deleted_total + count
			log("Data Cleanup Workflow rule days=%s doctype=Workflow Task deleted=%s" % (row.days, count))

	log("Data Cleanup: finished total_deleted=%s" % (deleted_total,))

run_data_cleanup()
